title: CHIEF
paper_title: A Pathology Foundation Model for Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis Prediction
core_mech: CHIEF 明确串联 CTransPath tile 自监督和带解剖条件的 WSI attention 弱监督，而非只发布局部 patch encoder。
core_mech_en: Couples self-supervised tile encoding (CTransPath) with anatomical-site-conditioned whole-slide attention aggregation trained across 60,530 WSIs.
input_desc: H&E WSI、tile 特征及训练时的癌症/解剖部位弱标签
input_en: H&E whole-slide image tiles + anatomical primary site text/categorical embedding
output_desc: 通用 tile embedding、WSI embedding 和诊断/预后任务输出
output_en: Slide-level diagnostic representation for cancer detection, tumor origin, genomic mutation, and survival prediction
